task: Extract all AWS region codes from a CloudFormation template parameter string

task: Create a JSON configuration object for an AWS Lambda function environment
solution_criteria: Valid JSON with Environment property containing Variables object with key-value pairs

task: Validate AWS EC2 security group rule format using regex

task: Create a JSON policy document for AWS S3 bucket access

task: Create a JSON object representing an AWS DynamoDB table schema with attributes and keys
